पांडवों को ज़िंदा जलाने की योजना बनी, तो वे लाक्षागृह से बचकर कैसे निकले? यह कथा महाभारत के आदि पर्व में, खंड एक सौ तैंतालीस से एक सौ इक्यावन तक आती है।

checks.name: no external link in the post (Facebook monetization/reach: keep viewers on Facebook)

monetizationNotes: Original content only: no reposts, no other creators' clips, no third-party watermarks (Meta deprioritises duplicative content; reported in secondary sources, verify in Monetization Manager).
Eligibility figures vary by source (5k-10k followers, watch-minute thresholds): check your Page in Meta Business Suite > Monetization before relying on any number.
A copyright check runs on every Reel upload (API: GET /{video-id}?fields=copyright_check_information). Our audio is procedural and our voice is synthetic; the paintings are public domain/CC0.
Long videos (Page videos) and Reels are separate surfaces: post the 16:9 film as a Page video and cut vertical Reels from it; in-stream ads are reported (secondary source) to need >= 3 minutes.
